evidence.title: Notifications Page for Shadcn UI – Admin Dashboard Template

name: Notifications Page
summary: Notifications page from the Shadcn UI Kit dashboard template: unread count, notification list, mark all as read, preferences.
description: Live demo of the notifications page in the Shadcn UI Kit pack (16 dashboards, $79). Manage user alerts, mark all as read and set notification preferences across a list of 21 notifications tagged Ticket, Team or Message, with a 4-unread badge and pagination. Built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
